SELECT
    hub.iata,
    hub.day,
    hub.n_dep,
    hub.avg_dep_delay,
    COALESCE(m.n_metar, 0) AS n_metar
FROM (

        f.iata,
        f.day,
        count() AS n_dep,
        round(avg(f.DepDelayMinutes), 2) AS avg_dep_delay

        SELECT Origin AS iata, FlightDate AS day, DepDelayMinutes

) hub

        toDate(m.valid_utc) AS day,
        count() AS n_metar
    FROM aviation.metar m
    JOIN aviation.airports a ON a.icao = m.station
    WHERE a.iata IN ('ATL','ORD','DFW','DEN','LAX')
    GROUP BY a.iata, day
) m ON m.iata = hub.iata AND m.day = hub.day"}

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB

categories = le.classes_

pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('tfidf', TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2), max_features=50000, min_df=2, sublinear_tf=True)),

])

pipeline.fit(train['text'], y)

# Predict on test set

test_pred_labels = le.transform(test_preds)
